feature: A long edit plays, scrubs and edits without a stutter (pass 21: a hunt starts moving at once and holds no frame)
summary: Dragging the playhead to hunt for a moment on the 6 minute edit now moves the picture from your first move, and a second hunt over the same ground no longer sits on one frame. Hunting, three runs in a row: the frame under the hand trails by at most 4 to 6 refreshes (was 17 to 22) and what you see by at most 2 to 3 (was 12 to 17); both medians 1. Nothing drawn changes.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The button on step 1 opens your own copy of the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev; File > Open reaches it too (Cmd-Shift-G, ~/Library/Caches/Photonz Reference Edit/Photonz Dev). Numbers come from Scripts/perf/speed-walk.sh (its hunt drags from 1:00 to 1:10 in two seconds) and a walk of three hunts in a row.

try.do: Open the 6 minute reference edit in Photonz Dev with the button below, then click the timeline ruler at 1:00.
Wait a moment, then drag the playhead steadily right, about ten seconds of the edit in two seconds.
Watch the first instant of the drag: the recording should move with your first move, not hold for a beat.
Click the ruler at 1:00 again and make the same drag a second time.
Keep dragging across the cut near 1:08 and watch the clip on the other side of it.

evaluate: Does the picture move from your very first move when you start dragging from a still playhead?
Does a second drag over the same stretch look as smooth as the first?
Does the clip after a cut show its own picture as soon as you cross into it?
rough: A fast drag across the whole edit (end to end in two seconds) is unchanged: it shows key frames, and the frame under the hand still trails by 33 to 61 refreshes in the middle. Covered by this task (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed).
Edits while playing are unchanged at 12 to 55 ms on their longest pass against a bar of 16. Covered by this task (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed).

The hunt's worst is still 4 to 6 refreshes against a bar of 1, in its first tenth of a second: the read around a still playhead covers only about half a second ahead when two recordings are on screen. Covered by this task (a-long-edit-with-transitions-plays-scrubs-and-ed).
No mock covers this: it is speed, not a surface.
